sentences.en: It comes from Lydie Klotz.
sentences.zh: 故事来自莱迪·克洛茨。

sentences.en: My high school had always gotten crushed in soccer by the West Hill Warriors.
sentences.zh: 我的高中足球队总是被西山勇士队打得落花流水。

sentences.en: We saw them as the rich kids from the city.
sentences.zh: 我们把他们看作城里的富家子弟。

sentences.en: One of their fathers took work calls on the sideline on the first mobile phone I ever saw.
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲中有人甚至用我见过的第一部移动电话在场边处理工作电话。

sentences.en: But my group of friends lived for soccer, and we had supportive parents too.
sentences.zh: 但我的朋友们热爱足球，我们也有支持我们的父母。

sentences.en: One of our parents parked a hay wagon on the sideline so that they could get elevated video footage of our games.
sentences.zh: 我们的一位家长在场边停了一辆干草车，这样他们就能从高处拍摄比赛录像。

sentences.en: And by the time we played West Hill my junior season, it was time for us to finally beat them.
sentences.zh: 到了我高三那年对阵西山队时，终于轮到我们击败他们了。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget, we were already ahead in this game, 2-0, when I dribbled past my defender near the halfway line and made a backdoor pass to my friend who scored,
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记，当时我们已经以 2-0 领先，我带球绕过防守队员，在半场线附近传出一记后门球，我的朋友接球得分，

sentences.en: which effectively ended the game.
sentences.zh: 这实际上终结了比赛。

sentences.en: And I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我当时太兴奋了。

sentences.en: As I ran to celebrate with my team, I screamed right in the face of West Hill's best player, a tall, blonde midfielder named Jeff Wendland.
sentences.zh: 当我跑向队友庆祝时，我对着西山队最好的球员——一个名叫杰夫·温德兰的高个子金发中场——的脸大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And Jeff was a big reason why we could never beat West Hill.
sentences.zh: 杰夫是我们一直无法击败西山队的主要原因。

sentences.en: He was skilled and smart and ultra competitive.
sentences.zh: 他技术精湛、头脑聪明，而且极具竞争意识。

sentences.en: I mean, he's the kind of guy who would sly tackle his grandmother to win.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他是那种为了赢球连祖母都会铲倒的人。

sentences.en: As soon as the final whistle blows for this game, Jeff makes a beeline right towards me.
sentences.zh: 比赛终场哨声一响，杰夫就径直朝我走来。

sentences.en: And my mind is racing for an excuse to justify why I screamed in his face.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑飞速运转，寻找借口来解释我为什么对他大喊大叫。

sentences.en: But when Jeff got to me, he just shook my hand, congratulated me on the win, and invited me to join his club team.
sentences.zh: 但当杰夫走到我面前时，他只是握了握我的手，祝贺我获胜，并邀请我加入他的俱乐部球队。

sentences.en: Now, this is a team that brought together the best players from all the high schools in our area.
sentences.zh: 那支球队汇集了我们地区所有高中里最优秀的球员，

sentences.en: and top college coaches paid attention to that club team.
sentences.zh: 顶尖的大学教练都会关注那支俱乐部球队。

sentences.en: So playing on that club team put my development as a soccer player on a whole new trajectory.
sentences.zh: 所以加入那支球队让我的足球生涯迈上了一个全新的台阶。

sentences.en: Jeff's invitation opened the door to the formative experiences of my young life,
sentences.zh: 杰夫的邀请为我开启了年轻生活中极具塑造意义的经历之门，

sentences.en: playing soccer at a Division I college and then for a couple years professionally.
sentences.zh: 让我得以在大学一级联赛踢球，后来还做了几年职业球员。

sentences.en: And in the decades since, I'm not a soccer player anymore, but I thought a lot about that moment.
sentences.zh: 几十年过去了，虽然我不再踢球了，但我经常想起那一刻。

sentences.en: Why didn't Jeff punch me in the face?
sentences.zh: 为什么杰夫没有揍我一拳？

sentences.en: Why didn't he just point out that despite my team beating his,
sentences.zh: 为什么他没有指出，尽管我的球队赢了他的球队，

sentences.en: he was still a better player than me, and he was.
sentences.zh: 但他依然比我强——事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: Why was Jeff so gracious?
sentences.zh: 为什么杰夫如此大度？

sentences.en: Jeff was only in high school,
sentences.zh: 杰夫当时还只是个高中生，

sentences.en: but he already figured out one of the most important things about competition.
sentences.zh: 但他已经领悟了竞争中最重要的事情之一。

sentences.en: And that's that the game was over.
